semiconductor_relevance: High — Naigai TEC Corporation is a key distributor of advanced optical image inspection equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on critical dimension measurement and contamination detection.
summary: Naigai TEC Corporation is the exclusive distributor of CRESSEM Co., Ltd. products in Japan, specializing in advanced optical image inspection systems for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include critical dimension measurement tools, die inspection systems, and contamination detection solutions, supporting various stages of semiconductor manufacturing.
